item.title: Julia Ducournau’s ALPHA Finally Has A Release Date
item.description: NEON has finally announced a theatrical release date for ALPHA, the genre-bending third feature from Julia Ducournau.

item.title: 16 New Horror Movies Streaming On Shudder This Month
item.description: Is it a SILENT NIGHT, DEADLY NIGHT or a REFLECTION IN A DEAD DIAMOND? There are so many possibilities as Shudder rolls out the frosty film frights in December.

item.title: Brace Yourselves, A HOT SPRING SHARK ATTACK Sequel Is Coming
item.description: Morihito Inoue’s toothy tokusatsu horror-comedy HOT SPRING SHARK ATTACK has a sequel swimming our way.

item.title: Watching IT: Welcome to Derry Episode 7 – “The Black Spot”
item.description: Stephen King experts and Kingcast hosts Anthony Breznican and Eric Vespe are heading back to Derry. Join them each week on Watching IT: Welcome to Derry as they break down every episode of HBO’s new series — unpacking the scares, the symbolism, and the easter eggs in their trademark blend of insight and smart-ass charm.

item.title: SINNERS Snaps Up Seven Golden Globe Nominations
item.description: Ryan Coogler's vampire epic SINNERS has snapped up seven Golden Globe nominations, including Best Picture - Drama and Best Director - Motion Picture.

item.title: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY’S 2 Just Murdered The Box Office
item.description: Freddy Fazbear lives! FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY’S 2 topped the box office with a bigger-than-expected opening, giving Blumhouse a much-needed win.

item.title: Sarah Squirm Is LIVE + IN THE FLESH And Isn’t Afraid To Gross You Out
item.description: SNL star Sarah Sherman is bringing her alter ego Sarah Squirm out to play for her stand-up special LIVE + IN THE FLESH, and we talked to her about creating the goopy, gory, and gross new show.

item.title: Alexander Skarsgård To Star In Gothic Horror THE WOLF WILL TEAR YOUR IMMACULATE HANDS
item.description: Alexander Skarsgård is set to star in THE WOLF WILL TEAR YOUR IMMACULATE HANDS, an upcoming Gothic horror feature from director Nathalie Álvarez Mesén.

item.title: Letterboxd Video Store Will Launch With One Of 2025’s Buzziest Horror Movies
item.description: Letterboxd has announced the launch date for their new Video Store, and with it, a chance to watch one of 2025's buzziest horror titles.

item.title: Horror Dominates IMDb’s Most Popular Movies of 2025
item.description: Horror absolutely dominated IMDb's most popular films and TV shows of 2025, with titles like WEAPONS and WEDNESDAY earning spots on the list.
